verdict.rationale: 2FAS documents that its mobile apps generate TOTP codes and positions itself as an easy way to enable 2FA on online accounts. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly describes adding a new account by scanning a QR code, so the onboarding half of the story is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation of QR-code scanning to add an account, evidence that codes start generating immediately after the scan, independent or hands-on corroboration of the setup flow.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can scan a QR code and immediately start generating TOTP codes for a new account

citations.quote: Generate TOTP, HOTP and Steam Guard codes on iOS, Android and via browser extensions.
2FAS Auth is the easiest way to enable two-factor authentication to verify your identity and securely sign-in to online accounts.
